tagline: Investing in dynamic neighborhoods across supply-constrained, high-barrier-to-entry markets in the United States.
hero_kpi_rationale: The 38.5% operating margin reflects Acadia's strong profitability after operating expenses, including general and administrative costs, demonstrating the efficiency of the REIT's business model focused on urban and suburban retail real estate.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: The percentage of revenue that becomes profit after all operating expenses.
kpis.description: Key profitability indicator after operating expenses, including general and administrative costs.
kpis.signal: Strong operating margin for a real estate investment trust (REIT).

kpis.name: Total Real Estate Portfolio
kpis.explanation: Total number of real estate properties owned or held through participations, including properties under development and redevelopment.
kpis.description: Portfolio comprising 228 properties, including 13 under development and 12 under redevelopment within the REIT Portfolio, supplemented by investments through the Investment Management platform.
kpis.signal: Diversified portfolio of urban retail and suburban shopping centers in high-barrier-to-entry markets.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.explanation: Total amount of the company's debt obligations, including real estate mortgages and credit facilities.
kpis.description: Total debt reflecting financing of the real estate portfolio and development activities, exposed to interest rate fluctuations (SOFR-based).
kpis.signal: Moderate leverage level typical of real estate investment trusts (REITs), with exposure to interest rate risk.

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

risks.title: Interest Rate Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to interest rate risk due to its debt structure, with loans indexed to SOFR (SOFR + 1.20% to SOFR + 2.65%). Rising interest rates directly increase debt servicing costs.

risks.title: Significant Leverage
risks.score_rationale: The company carries a significant total debt of $435.5 million, which could affect its ability to repay debt and its financial flexibility.

risks.title: Real Estate Asset Depreciation
risks.score_rationale: Real estate assets in the portfolio are subject to depreciation charges, as noted in risk factors. Revaluation of fair value could result in losses.

risks.title: Portfolio Concentration and Market Risks
risks.score_rationale: The portfolio is highly concentrated in urban and suburban retail across specific geographic markets, with exposure to retail sector risks and e-commerce disruption.

risks.title: Lease Renewal and Tenant Risks
risks.score_rationale: The ability to renew leases on favorable terms and reliance on key tenants (particularly anchor tenants) are critical to the business model. Risk of non-renewal or bankruptcy of major tenants could significantly reduce revenues.

risks.title: Liquidity and Capital Markets Access Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on access to capital markets for refinancing and acquisitions. Disruptions in financial and banking markets could limit its ability to raise capital.

ai_positioning.summary: The company AKR mentions risks associated with the use of AI tools in its operations and communications, including risks of reputational harm and legal or regulatory liability. No indication of strategic AI use to create value.
evidence: risks associated with our use of AI tools, which could result in reputational harm, and legal or regulatory liability
